content: Large Data Path IF TriggerTransmit Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_00060 When Com_TriggerTransmit is invoked for an I-PDU with ComIPduLargeData set to true, AUTOSAR COM module shall use the passed I-PDU ID as Handle Id ( ComIPduHandleId ) to derive the corresponding <ComUser_ComCbkTrigger- Transmit> user notification callback and call it with the according Com user callback handle Id.
